program:

count(exam_task where done = no) "open" head

"Done" faint
list exam_task where done = yes

    - text: the due of the exam task.
- a form to add a exam task.

- a list of exam task where done is yes; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.

program:

  stack card gap 1 tap edit c

    - text: "Harvested", the total kg of the crop's harvest entries, "kg".
    - text: "Per acre", the total kg of the crop's harvest entries divided by the larger of the acres of the crop and 0.1 rounded, "kg".

program:
app "Salon products" star mint
table product_s name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 5, price money?
state q text = ""
let short = count(product_s, it.qty <= it.low)
short "products running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
field q "Search"
each product_s where has(name, q) sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
"Stock value" sum(product_s, it.qty * it.price) faint
form product_s
remind "Check your products" at 9:00 on sat
describe:
Salon products, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- product s: name: text; qty: number, at least 0; low: number, at least 0, starts at 5; price: money, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- short is how many of the product s have its qty is at most its low.
Remembers while you use it: q, starting at "".
Shows:
- text: short, "products running low".
- a box to fill in q, labelled "Search".
- for each product s where name contains q sorted by qty:
  - a group; a tap opens the product s for editing; a swipe removes the product s, with undo:
    - text: the name of the product s.
    - a button "-"; a tap sets the qty of the product s to the qty of the product s minus 1.
    - text: the qty of the product s.

program:
app "Stopwatch" timer ocean
table lap time dur
state t dur = 0s
state going bool = no
every 1s if going set t = t + 1s
stack align center gap 2
  t big
  row gap 2
    button "Start" fill good tap set going = yes
    button "Stop" fill bad tap set going = no
    button "Lap" tap add lap time = t
    button "Reset" tap set going = no then set t = 0s
each lap sort at desc
  row card
    "Lap" count(lap) - index grow
    it.time bold
describe:
Stopwatch, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- lap: time: length of time. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Remembers while you use it: t, starting at 0 hours; going, starting at no.
Shows:
- every 1 seconds while going, it sets t to t plus 1 seconds.
- text: t.
- a button "Start"; a tap sets going to yes.
- a button "Stop"; a tap sets going to no.
- a button "Lap"; a tap adds a lap with time set to t.
- a button "Reset"; a tap sets going to no, then sets t to 0 hours.
- for each lap sorted by at, highest first:
  - text: "Lap", how many lap entries minus its position.
  - text: its time.

program:
app "Sale price" tag mint
state price money = 0
state off num = 20
state off2 num = 0
field price "Price tag"
field off "Discount %"
field off2 "Extra discount %"
let final = price * (1 - off / 100) * (1 - off2 / 100)
"You pay" round(final) big
"You save" round(price - final) bold color good
describe:
Sale price, in the mint colours.
Works out:
- final is price times the result of 1 minus off divided by 100 times the result of 1 minus off2 divided by 100.
Remembers while you use it: price, starting at 0; off, starting at 20; off2, starting at 0.
Shows:
- a box to fill in price, labelled "Price tag".
- a box to fill in off, labelled "Discount %".
- a box to fill in off2, labelled "Extra discount %".
- text: "You pay", final rounded.
- text: "You save", price minus final rounded.

program:
app "Books this year" book plum
table finished title text, author text?
setting goal num = 24 "Books a year"
goal count(finished year), goal, "books read"
plot 0..12, 0..max(max(1..12, count(finished where month(at) = it and year(at) = year(today))), 1) axes
  each 1..12 as mo
    rect index + 0.15, 0, 0.7, count(finished where month(at) = mo and year(at) = year(today)) fill accent radius 2
    tick index + 0.5, monthname(addmonths(today, mo - month(today)))
form finished, "Finished a book"
describe:
Books this year, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- finished: title: text; author: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Books a year": number, starts at 24.
Shows:
- how many finished entries this year out of goal with a progress bar, labelled "books read".
- a form to add a finished.

fuller_style: two sentences, 20 to 35 words

table tick child ref child
row gap 1
  stack gap 1
    box height 32
    each days week as d

        dayname(d) faint
  each child as c
    stack grow gap 1 align center
      c.name bold

form child, "Add child"
describe:

program:
app "Exam marks" pen ocean
setting aim num = 80 "Target percent"
table exam subject text, score num 0.., outof num 1.. = 100
"Overall" round(sum(exam.score) * 100 / max(sum(exam.outof), 1)) "%" big
goal round(sum(exam.score) * 100 / max(sum(exam.outof), 1)), aim, "average so far", "%"
trend exam, it.score * 100 / it.outof
each exam sort at desc top 8 as e
  row gap 2
    e.subject grow
    e.score "/" e.outof bold
form exam, "Add result"
describe:
Exam marks, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- exam: subject: text; score: number, at least 0; outof: number, at least 1, starts at 100. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Target percent": number, starts at 80.
Shows:
- text: "Overall", the total score of exam times 100 divided by the larger of the total outof of exam and 1 rounded, "%".
- the total score of exam times 100 divided by the larger of the total outof of exam and 1 rounded out of aim with a progress bar, labelled "average so far".
- a line chart of its score times 100 divided by its outof over exam.
- for each exam sorted by at, highest first, first 8:
  - text: the subject of the exam.
  - text: the score of the exam, "/", the outof of the exam.
- a form to add a exam.
hurried_style: all lowercase, no punctuation, 2 to 8 words
fuller_style: chatty with a reason why the person needs it, 22 to 38 words
